datasheet.title: Samsung Electro-Mechanics MLCC catalogue (Multilayer Ceramic Capacitors)

sources: Samsung Electro-Mechanics MLCC catalogue, November 2015 (LCSC's copy, edakit part fetch C28323, sha256 96baebe4bd0c…, read 2026-10-31): p. 4 Part Numbering System – CL = MLCC, 21 = 0805 (2012), B = X7R, 105 = 10 × 10^5 pF = 1 µF, K = ±10 %, B = 50 V, F = thickness 1.25 mm, N = Ni/Cu/Ni barrier/Sn 100 %, N = normal, N = reserved, E = embossed tape 7" reel
same catalogue p. 5 class II table: B = X7R, –55 … +125 °C, ±15 %

pin numbers and names, footprint C0805, jlc_class: EasyEDA library data of C28323 (edakit part import, 2026-10-31); JLCPCB catalogue 2026-10-31: Basic Part, 2 359 501 pcs; LCSC product data 2026-10-31: 187 820 pcs, RoHS

compliance.source: Samsung MLCC catalogue November 2015, p. 2 ('all our MLCCs are produced in accordance with EU ROHS and REACH Directive'); LCSC product data C28323 (isEnvironment), read 2026-10-31

notes: 1 µF / 50 V X7R in 0805 (JLCPCB Basic): the EN delay capacitor of block esp32-wroom-32e (ESP32 module datasheet: 10 kΩ / 1 µF).
